Your server is now in creative mode and its description says **Mossy Hollow**.

**What I changed** in the server settings file (`server.properties`):
- `gamemode`: `survival` → `creative`
- `motd` (the description players see in their server list): `Welcome` → `Mossy Hollow`

I saved a copy of the original file as `server.properties.pre-edit.bak` in case you want to undo it. Then I restarted the server. It started up normally, its log shows "Default game type: CREATIVE", and both settings were still in place after the restart.

**Players who have joined before** will still be in survival when they come back. This setting only applies to new players. To switch existing players, you can:
- Run `/gamemode creative <player>` for each player (you need to be an operator to use it), or
- Ask us to turn on `force-gamemode`, which puts everyone in creative every time they join.

If the description still says "Welcome", refresh your server list.
